topic: Temporary derogation from selected ePrivacy Directive provisions

official_evidence.note: States that the expired Regulation 2021/1232 could no longer be extended and that the Council intended to adopt its full text as a new self-standing Regulation with adaptations.
Published 28 July 2026; Article 11 provides entry into force on the third day following publication and application until 3 April 2028.

foundation_assertion: Genealogical or thematic succession does not imply uninterrupted applicability; the 118-day 2026 gap is live-verified from official Cellar bytes.
